verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at shared credentials. Agents get integrations via a Connectors section, and enterprise Slack access runs requests on a shared organization service account instead of personal accounts, which implies some org-level credential sharing. Nothing documents a central credential vault, team sharing of individual connections, or per-credential access control; the Owner/User roles govern agents, not credentials. Missing for 10: documented central credential store, explicit sharing of connections with teammates, per-credential permissions/RBAC, independent corroboration.
